content.short: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol built on Ethereum offering USDe, a yield-bearing stablecoin backed by delta-neutral staked ETH positions.
content.description: Ethena Labs has built a novel synthetic dollar protocol that generates yield through delta-neutral hedging of staked Ethereum, with its USDe stablecoin maintaining its peg via a combination of ETH collateral and short perpetual futures positions. Stakers receive sUSDe, which accrues funding rate yields making it one of DeFi's highest-yielding dollar instruments. Ethena has grown to billions in TVL since its 2024 launch and its integration with Mantle enables users to access deep USDe liquidity and high-yield USD exposure within the ecosystem.
